# Steps and their roll-up

> the generic step — its tasks by stage, a handling per sample, and the roll-up every step shares

**Types:** `Step`, `Task`, `Handling` (package Steps)

**Commands in:** DeviationPending, DeviationResolved, Expect, Haemolysed, Missing, Plan, Rejected, SampleStopped

**Events out:** SampleStopped

**Policies reacting:** sample_stopped (on SampleStopped)

[All topics](index.md)

## Rules

<a id="R1"></a>
### R1 — A step rolls up from its tasks, one per stage

`agreed` · definitional · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

Every step of a route — a site visit, a transfer, an analysis, and the route itself — has a task per stage (start, middle, final) and, on each task, a handling per sample. A step's status is read from its tasks', a task's from its handlings'.

- **Model:** `Step`, `Task`
- **Shown by:** 01-two-tubes-to-the-lab

<a id="R2"></a>
### R2 — The latest stage reached decides failure

`agreed` · table · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

When every task of a step has ended, the latest stage that had work to do decides: if none of its tasks completed, the step failed.

| final stage | middle stage | start stage | the step |
|---|---|---|---|
| none completed | any | any | failed |
| not needed | none completed | any | failed |
| not needed | not needed | none completed | failed |
| all completed | all completed | all completed | completed |

- **Model:** `Step.in_progress on_children tasks.all_final#failed_at_final`, `Step.in_progress on_children tasks.all_final#failed_at_middle`, `Step.in_progress on_children tasks.all_final#failed_at_start`
- **Shown by:** 02-haemolysed-at-the-lab, 04-stability-expired

<a id="R3"></a>
### R3 — A sample stopped elsewhere counts neither way

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

A task still waiting for a sample that failed earlier no longer expects it. A task none of whose samples reached it is not needed — not failed.

- **Model:** `Task.created on_children handlings.all_final#not_needed`, `Handling.open on SampleStopped`, `sample_stopped`
- **Shown by:** 04-stability-expired, 05-one-of-two-haemolysed
